name: leduc
description: Leduc hold'em as in OpenSpiel leduc_poker (Southey et al. 2005): 6 cards (J, Q, K in suits s, h), ante 1, raises 2 then 4, at most 2 raises per round, player 0 first in both rounds, pair beats high card. Infoset ids: '<card>:<r1>' and '<card>|<public>:<r1>/<r2>' with f=fold, c=call/check, r=raise.
